description: Familiarity with sensors, actuators and microcontroller-based Arduino and Raspberry Pi platform. Writing C programs in Arduino IDE. Understanding of the communication between microcontroller and PC using serial communication. Knowledge of the design of IoT based applications.

syllabus.title: Introduction to Internet of Things
syllabus.body: Applications/Devices, Protocols and Communication Model, the Physical Design/Logical Design of IoT, Functional blocks of IoT and Communication Models, Development Tools used in IoT.

syllabus.title: Things and Connections
syllabus.body: Working of Controlled Systems: Real-time systems with feedback loop, Connectivity models, different type of modes using wired and wireless methodology.

syllabus.title: Sensors, Actuators and Microcontrollers
syllabus.body: Types of sensors, actuator and actuators controller, Microcontroller vs microprocessor, different types of microcontrollers in embedded ecosystem.

syllabus.title: Building IoT applications using Arduino
syllabus.body: Introduction to Arduino IDE, Embedded 'C' Language basics, interfacing sensors, interfacing LED, Button, Sensors-DHT, LDR, MQ135, IR.

syllabus.title: Building IoT applications using Raspberry Pi
syllabus.body: Raspberry Pi Hardware, Versions, Accessories, Precautions, Raspberry Pi Software – Operating System, Communicating and Connecting, Programming on the Raspberry Pi.

outcomes: Awareness of basic concepts, principles and challenges in IoT.
Understanding of the functioning of hardware devices and sensors used for IoT.
Ability to analyze network communication aspects and protocols used in IoT.
Apply IoT for developing applications using Arduino programming.
textbooks: Macro Schwartz, "Internet of Things with Arduino – Cookbook", Packt 2016.
Arshdeep Bajga and Vijay Madisetti, "Internet of Things- A Hands-on Approach" Universities Press, 2014.
Derek Molloy, "Exploring Raspberry Pi: Interfacing to the Real World with Embedded Linux", John Wiley & Sons, 2016.
referenceBooks: G. R. Kanagachidambaresan, "Internet of Things Using Single Board Computers: Principles of IoT and Python Programming", Apress, 2022.
